execution.description: Ran suite checks selected by test id with pytest -k.

expected: pytest exits 0 when every selected check passes.
observed: The invariants conftest exits 1 whenever any test is deselected, even when every selected test passes.
keep: The deselection guard; it stops a partial run passing as a full one.
change: The coverage runner reads pytest's summary and records which checks ran, rather than trusting the exit code alone.
